017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.metrics.micrometer;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.StringUtils.*;
021
022import java.time.*;
023
024import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.metrics.*;
025
026import io.micrometer.core.instrument.*;
027
028/**
029 * {@link MetricsRecorder} bridge that records every {@code @RestOp} call as a Micrometer
030 * {@link Timer} sample on the configured {@link MeterRegistry}.
031 *
032 * <h5 class='topic'>Metric shape</h5>
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * Each call records to one Timer named (by default) {@value #DEFAULT_TIMER_NAME} with four tags:
036 * <ul>
037 *    <li><b>{@code method}</b> &mdash; uppercased HTTP method (e.g. {@code GET}, {@code POST}).
038 *    <li><b>{@code uri}</b> &mdash; the {@code @RestOp} path template (e.g. {@code /users/{id}}), not
039 *       the raw concrete URI. Using the template keeps tag cardinality bounded; raw URIs
040 *       ({@code /users/123}, {@code /users/124}, ...) would explode the registry's series count.
041 *       Empty string when the operation has no path pattern.
042 *    <li><b>{@code status}</b> &mdash; HTTP response status code as a string (e.g. {@code 200},
043 *       {@code 404}, {@code 500}).
044 *    <li><b>{@code exception}</b> &mdash; the thrown exception's simple-name (e.g. {@code BadRequest},
045 *       {@code NullPointerException}), or {@value #NO_EXCEPTION_TAG} when the call completed normally.
046 * </ul>
047 *
048 * <p>
049 * The shape mirrors Spring Boot's
050 * <a class="doclink" href="https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/docs/current/reference/htmlsingle/#actuator.metrics.supported.spring-mvc">{@code WebMvcMetricsFilter}</a>
051 * convention so existing dashboards / alerts that scrape {@code http.server.requests} from Spring
052 * Boot services keep working when those services are reimplemented on Juneau.
053 *
054 * <h5 class='topic'>Wiring</h5>
055 *
056 * <p class='bjava'>
057 *    <ja>@Configuration</ja>
058 *    <jk>public class</jk> ObservabilityConfig {
059 *
060 *       <ja>@Bean</ja>
061 *       <jk>public</jk> MeterRegistry meterRegistry() {
062 *          <jk>return new</jk> PrometheusMeterRegistry(PrometheusConfig.<jsf>DEFAULT</jsf>);
063 *       }
064 *
065 *       <ja>@Bean</ja>
066 *       <jk>public</jk> MetricsRecorder metricsRecorder(MeterRegistry <jv>r</jv>) {
067 *          <jk>return new</jk> MicrometerMetricsRecorder(<jv>r</jv>);
068 *       }
069 *    }
070 * </p>
071 *
072 * <p>
073 * The {@code MetricsRecorder} bean is picked up by {@code juneau-rest-server} through the
074 * {@code RestContext}'s bean store and invoked once per {@code @RestOp} call.
075 *
076 * <h5 class='topic'>Customizing the metric name</h5>
077 *
078 * <p>
079 * Pass a non-default name to the two-arg constructor when the default
080 * {@value #DEFAULT_TIMER_NAME} doesn't match an existing dashboard / Prometheus rule set:
081 *
082 * <p class='bjava'>
083 *    <jk>new</jk> MicrometerMetricsRecorder(<jv>r</jv>, <js>"my.service.http.timer"</js>)
084 * </p>
085 *
086 * <p>
087 * Per-operation overrides are available via {@link org.apache.juneau.rest.server.RestOp#metricName()}.
088 * When a non-empty {@code metricName} is passed to {@code record(...)}, it takes precedence over the
089 * recorder-level timer name. Per-op tags added via {@link org.apache.juneau.rest.server.RestOp#metricTags()}
090 * are merged into the standard tag set as additional {@code key=value} pairs.
091 *
092 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
093 *    <li class='jc'>{@link MetricsRecorder}
094 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/RestServerObservability">REST Server &mdash; Observability (Micrometer + OpenTelemetry)</a>
095 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://micrometer.io/docs/concepts">Micrometer Concepts</a>
096 * </ul>
097 *
098 * @since 10.0.0
099 */
100@SuppressWarnings({
101   "java:S1192", // Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants
102   "java:S6213" // Method name 'record' is part of the established MetricsRecorder SPI; renaming this overriding method would be a breaking API change.
103})
104public class MicrometerMetricsRecorder implements MetricsRecorder {
105
106   /** Default timer name {@code "http.server.requests"} &mdash; matches Spring Boot's convention. */
107   public static final String DEFAULT_TIMER_NAME = "http.server.requests";
108
109   /** Tag value used for the {@code exception} tag when the call completed normally. */
110   public static final String NO_EXCEPTION_TAG = "None";
111
112   private final MeterRegistry registry;
113   private final String timerName;
114
115   /**
116    * Constructor using the default timer name {@value #DEFAULT_TIMER_NAME}.
117    *
118    * @param registry The Micrometer {@link MeterRegistry} to publish timers to. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
119    */
120   public MicrometerMetricsRecorder(MeterRegistry registry) {
121      this(registry, DEFAULT_TIMER_NAME);
122   }
123
124   /**
125    * Constructor with a custom timer name.
126    *
127    * @param registry The Micrometer {@link MeterRegistry} to publish timers to. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
128    * @param timerName The timer name. Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
129    */
130   public MicrometerMetricsRecorder(MeterRegistry registry, String timerName) {
131      this.registry = reqnn("registry", registry);
132      this.timerName = reqnb("timerName", timerName);
133   }
134
135   /**
136    * Returns the {@link MeterRegistry} this recorder publishes to.
137    *
138    * @return The {@link MeterRegistry}.
139    */
140   public MeterRegistry getRegistry() { return registry; }
141
142   /**
143    * Returns the configured timer name.
144    *
145    * @return The timer name.
146    */
147   public String getTimerName() { return timerName; }
148
149   @Override /* MetricsRecorder */
150   public void record(String opName, String httpMethod, String uriTemplate, int statusCode, Duration elapsed, Throwable error, String metricName, String metricTags) {
151      var effectiveName = ine(metricName) ? metricName : timerName;
152      var builder = Timer.builder(effectiveName)
153         .tag("method", defaultIfBlank(httpMethod, ""))
154         .tag("uri", defaultIfBlank(uriTemplate, ""))
155         .tag("status", Integer.toString(statusCode))
156         .tag("exception", exceptionTag(error));
157      builder = applyMetricTags(builder, metricTags);
158      builder.register(registry).record(elapsed);
159   }
160
161   @Override /* MetricsRecorder */
162   public void record(String metricName, String metricTags, Duration elapsed, Throwable error) {
163      // Custom (non-request) observation: a timer named metricName carrying only the exception tag
164      // plus any caller-supplied metricTags - no HTTP method/uri/status tags (there is no request).
165      var builder = Timer.builder(metricName)
166         .tag("exception", exceptionTag(error));
167      builder = applyMetricTags(builder, metricTags);
168      builder.register(registry).record(elapsed);
169   }
170
171   private static Timer.Builder applyMetricTags(Timer.Builder builder, String metricTags) {
172      if (ine(metricTags))
173         for (var pair : metricTags.split(",")) {
174            var kv = pair.split("=", 2);
175            if (kv.length == 2)
176               builder = builder.tag(kv[0].strip(), kv[1].strip());
177         }
178      return builder;
179   }
180
181   private static String exceptionTag(Throwable error) {
182      return error == null ? NO_EXCEPTION_TAG : cns(error);
183   }
184
185   private static String defaultIfBlank(String value, String fallback) {
186      return isEmpty(value) ? fallback : value;
187   }
188}
